frontPage.headline: Public Accounts Committee Flags Unutilized Cess Collections Diverted Away From Reserve Funds
frontPage.summary: Parliament's Public Accounts Committee (PAC) questioned the Finance Ministry over its failure to transfer ₹9,222 crore collected via cesses into dedicated non-lapsable reserve funds. The panel emphasized that cess proceeds are non-shareable revenues earmarked for designated purposes and must not be retained within the Consolidated Fund of India to artificially cushion fiscal deficits.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Connects directly to Parliamentary oversight, fiscal federalism, and the accounting transparency of non-tax revenue/cesses under GS II and GS III Public Finance.

frontPage.headline: India Formally Completes Operationalizing Dedicated Freight Corridor Network across 2,843 km
frontPage.summary: India completed its landmark Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) initiative with the inauguration of final sections across the Eastern (EDFC) and Western (WDFC) networks. Spanning 2,843 km, the dedicated corridors decouple freight traffic from passenger routes, significantly lowering logistics costs, accelerating transit speeds, and boosting industrial competitiveness.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Crucial infrastructure development topic for GS III Economy, focusing on national logistics efficiency, supply chain bottlenecks, and multimodal connectivity.

frontPage.headline: India and China Hold First Corps Commander-Level Talks in Eastern Sector Post-Escalation
frontPage.summary: India and China conducted a two-day Corps Commander-level dialogue focusing on the Eastern Sector of the Line of Actual Control (LAC). The Ministry of External Affairs noted that bilateral engagements are gradually stabilizing military deployments and restoring political confidence along contested Himalayan frontiers.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Border security and diplomatic relations with China are central to GS II International Relations and GS III Internal Security.

frontPage.headline: Supreme Court Refuses Extension to Aravalli Panel, Sets Firm Deadline for Regulatory Framework
frontPage.summary: The Supreme Court declined to grant additional time to a high-powered committee tasked with defining the ecologically sensitive Aravalli range and regulating illegal mining. The court directed the panel to submit a uniform definition and actionable conservation guidelines by November 30 to curb irreversible desertification in North India.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Crucial for GS III Environment and Ecology topics covering mining regulations, desertification barriers, and environmental governance.

frontPage.headline: US-Iran Escalation Drives Crude Prices Toward $100/Barrel, Threatening Global Energy Stability
frontPage.topic: West Asian Conflict & Global Energy Security
frontPage.summary: Direct military exchanges between US forces and Iranian naval/oil infrastructure near Kharg Island and the Strait of Hormuz sent global crude oil prices surging toward $100 per barrel. The escalation risks disrupting energy shipping corridors critical for net oil-importing economies like India.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Spans GS II (Geopolitics of West Asia) and GS III (Macroeconomic stability, imported inflation, energy security).

frontPage.headline: Supreme Court Warns States Against Diluting Teacher Eligibility Standards in Private Schools
frontPage.topic: Issues Relating to Development and Management of Education
frontPage.summary: The Supreme Court held that absorbing or regularizing unqualified private school teachers without mandatory qualifications violates the Right to Education (RTE) framework. The apex court stressed that compromised teacher quality directly undermines foundational learning outcomes for students.
frontPage.whyItMatters: Relevant to GS II Social Justice (Education policy, Right to Education Act implementation, governance of primary education).

gs1.headline: Kashmiri Mysticism Preserved Through Traditional Pashmina Weaving Artistry
gs1.summary: Artisans in Jammu & Kashmir are integrating the 14th-century mystic poetry of Lalleshwari (Lal Ded) into intricate Pashmina textile designs. Lalleshwari was a pioneer of the Bhakti-Sufi syncretic tradition and Lal Vakh (poetic verses) in Kashmiri literature.
gs1.whyItMatters: Connects to Medieval Indian History, Bhakti movement saints, and traditional handicraft heritage under GS I Art & Culture.

gs2.headline: Delhi High Court Censures Inclusion of Sexual Harassment Survivor's Identity in Official Handbook
gs2.topic: Protection of Women & Workplace Harassment Framework
gs2.summary: The Delhi High Court severely criticized executive authorities for disclosing the name of a sexual harassment survivor in a government-published POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) training handbook. The court emphasized that maintaining confidentiality is a non-negotiable statutory mandate to protect victim dignity and enable safe reporting.
gs2.whyItMatters: Demonstrates gaps in institutional execution of POSH Act guidelines and right-to-privacy protections in governance.

gs2.headline: Defense Minister Visits Sri Lanka to Deepen Security and Maritime Ties under SAGAR Vision
gs2.summary: India's Defense Minister initiated a three-day official visit to Sri Lanka to review bilateral defense infrastructure cooperation, maritime domain awareness, and joint capacity building in the Indian Ocean Region.
gs2.whyItMatters: Highlights India's 'Neighbourhood First' policy and SAGAR (Security and Growth for All in the Region) initiative amidst Indian Ocean geopolitical competition.

gs3.headline: Study Highlights Monetary Policy Limitations: Flat Phillips Curve and High Inflation Expectations in India
gs3.summary: An empirical analysis of India's Inflation Targeting Framework reveals a flat Phillips curve alongside elevated household inflation expectations relative to RBI targets. The study indicates that aggressive monetary tightening may suppress real output and employment without proportionately dampening supply-side food and fuel shocks.
gs3.whyItMatters: Provides analytical fodder for Mains questions assessing the efficacy, structural limitations, and target flexibility of RBI's Flexible Inflation Targeting (FIT) regime.

gs3.headline: Assam Eco-Sensitive Zone Notification Controversy Surrounding Kaziranga Wildlife Corridors
gs3.topic: Conservation, Environmental Impact Assessment & Wildlife Corridors
gs3.summary: A major policy conflict has emerged over proposals to reduce the Eco-Sensitive Zone (ESZ) buffer around Kaziranga National Park to 1 km from the 10 km normative standard. Environmentalists have raised alarms over the omission of vital animal movement corridors, including Panbari, from official gazette maps, threatening the ecological integrity of the elephant and rhino habitat.
gs3.whyItMatters: Directly links to GS III topics on linear infrastructure impacts, land-use conflicts around protected areas, and corridor conservation.

gs3.headline: India Joins US-Led International Coalition to Accelerate Next-Generation 6G Telecom Standards
gs3.topic: Awareness in Science and Technology: Telecommunications
gs3.summary: India has formally joined a multilateral partnership led by advanced economies to co-develop international standards, open architecture, and resilient supply chains for 6G wireless communication technology. The collaboration focuses on securing next-gen communication infrastructure and spectrum harmonizing.
gs3.whyItMatters: Relevant for critical emerging technologies, digital public infrastructure, and strategic international technology alliances under GS III S&T.

gs3.headline: Agnikul Cosmos Unveils Dedicated Infrastructure for Reusable Rocket Stage Validation
gs3.summary: Private space tech startup Agnikul Cosmos inaugurated integrated testing and additive manufacturing facilities in Chennai to support reusable launch vehicle development. This infrastructure aims to lower payload delivery costs and accelerate commercial launch schedules under India's liberalized space policy.
gs3.whyItMatters: Highlights private sector participation in deep tech, commercial space missions, and advanced manufacturing in India.

prelimsRadar.detail: Gained news attention following direct strikes on surrounding oil tankers during regional escalations.

prelimsRadar.detail: Aims to isolate extremely faint radio signals obscured by solar and galactic noise background.

prelimsRadar.detail: Parity established between rural and urban Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana / LPG domestic beneficiaries.

prelimsRadar.detail: Subject of a Supreme Court hearing regarding implementation deadlines for power plants.

quiz.question:
Regarding the dedicated non-lapsable funds created out of cess collections in India, consider the following statements:
1. Proceeds from cesses form part of the divisible pool of taxes shared with State Governments under Article 270.
2. Cesses collected by the Union must be transferred to designated reserve funds established in the Public Account of India.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
quiz.explanation: Cesses collected by the Central Government do not form part of the divisible pool of taxes distributed among states under Article 270. They are earmarked for specific expenditures and must be transferred to designated reserve funds in the Public Account of India.

quiz.question: Which of the following statements regarding the Eastern and Western Dedicated Freight Corridors (DFCs) is correct?
options: The Western DFC connects Ludhiana in Punjab to Dankuni in West Bengal.
The Eastern DFC terminates at Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust (JNPT) near Mumbai.
DFCs are designed exclusively for freight trains, operating with higher axle loads and speeds.
DFCs are fully funded and owned by the International Monetary Fund.
quiz.explanation: DFCs are dedicated rail corridors built exclusively to carry heavy freight traffic with 25 to 32.5-tonne axle loads at speeds up to 100 km/h. EDFC runs from Ludhiana to Dankuni/Sonnagar, while WDFC connects Dadri to JNPT.

quiz.question: With reference to 21-cm radio astronomy, what does the 21-cm line primarily allow astronomers to map?
options: Distribution of neutral atomic hydrogen across cosmic time
Gamma-ray bursts from deep space black holes
quiz.explanation: The 21-cm spectral line is emitted by neutral atomic hydrogen. Detecting this signal allows cosmologists to probe the Cosmic Dawn and Epoch of Reionization when the first stars began forming.

quiz.question:
With reference to Eco-Sensitive Zones (ESZs) in India, consider the following statements:
1. ESZs are notified by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change under the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972.
2. The main objective of declaring ESZs is to create shock absorbers around protected areas by regulating human activities.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
quiz.explanation: Statement 1 is incorrect: ESZs are notified under Section 3(2)(v) of the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986, not the Wildlife Protection Act. Statement 2 is correct.

quiz.question: Which saint-poetess of medieval India composed mystic verses known as 'Vakhs' in the Kashmiri language?
quiz.explanation: Lalleshwari (Lal Ded) was a 14th-century Shaivite mystic poetess from Kashmir who composed short four-line devotional poems called 'Vakhs'.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) / Domestic LPG Distribution Framework
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.beneficiaries: BPL households and rural domestic consumers
schemes.objective: Provide clean cooking fuel to rural households to eliminate indoor air pollution and health hazards associated with burning biomass.
keyFeatures: Refill booking interval for rural consumers shortened from 45 to 25 days to match urban standards.
Targeted digital refill tracking and direct benefit transfer (DBT) of subsidies.
schemes.funding: Centrally sponsored budget allocations and oil marketing company support.
schemes.upscRelevance: GS II Welfare Schemes & GS III Energy Access/Gender Health.

points: PAC Findings on Cess Management: Over ₹9,200 crore of collected cess proceeds were not credited to earmarked non-lapsable funds, leading to opaque fiscal accounting.
Policy Impact: Using dedicated cess revenue to artificially pad the Consolidated Fund of India weakens parliamentary budget oversight and breaches statutory mandates.
Completion of Dedicated Freight Corridors (2,843 km): Frees up over 70% of existing trunk rail lines by segregating freight movements.
Efficiency Gains: Expected to reduce national logistics costs from ~13-14% of GDP toward global benchmarks of 8-9%.

Supreme Court Observation on RTE and Quality Education: Absorbing untrained/unqualified teaching staff in schools directly violates children's fundamental right to quality education under Article 21A.
